dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: It's so difficult for students to buckle down nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: *sigh* Hi, you got any questions? Go ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: Hmm? You are not a student here to ask questions?

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: Of course they can, but it matters what kind of questions they're asking.

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: The students nowadays... They are asking questions before even reading through their textbooks. Is it so hard to know the basics first?

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: These little bastards keep bothering me. Even my good temper failed me.

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: But ever since I started to do it my old classmate Tighnari's way, yelling "Don't move anything. Don't touch anything. If you don't already know all about something, then don't ask about it" to them several times,

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: They kind of figured what was going on and stopped bothering me with stupid questions.

dialogues.speaker: Hazm
dialogues.text: It was brutal, but at least I taught them to think independently.
